clauses.title: CL-D97 records where validation commands come from and what none means
clauses.section: ## CL-D97 — Validation commands without a committed .tidd.json
requires: The head is never a source, and the run records the source it used and names it first in the validation line
Exact autofix with none stops `BLOCKED` before the operator capture, naming both places
Reading commands from the head, guessing them, or letting exact autofix run without them requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: CL-D93 names the fallback
clauses.section: ## CL-D93 — A packaged driver sequences the review; the parent only makes the calls it prints
requires: CL-D97 later let a missing base file fall back to `--validate` or the operator's own configuration, and review-only proceed with none.

clauses.title: The CL-D97 fixtures drive each source
requires: Issue #209 review-only with no validation commands runs git diff --check only and says so
Issue #209 validation commands resolve from the base file, then --validate or the operator configuration
Issue #196 a .tidd.json added only at the head is not read
